Morgan: kicking off EdgeFrame POC asks — SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning with role mapping, domain ownership verification, and a pricing comparison Dedicated vs Private for a 2-week trial. Need answers before Friday kickoff.
Lina: I'll send SAML & SCIM samples. Quick question: persistent NameID vs email? Any custom SCIM attrs (employeeType/team_id)?
Raj: For RBAC propose groups->roles mapping and roles[] claim in token. For POC use groups-only SCIM push. Ask customer for canonical role list.
Sasha: Ballpark pricing: 2-week Dedicated trial (small GPU pool + burst + basic support) ≈ $5k. Private POC higher (~$12–18k) due to infra & security review. I'll get exact numbers from finance tomorrow.
legal: Reviewed their security questionnaire. No blockers. For Private we can offer customer-managed KMS/HSM and audit log exports, but need a deployment addendum and confirmation of retention window (they asked 90 days vs our default 30).
infra-bot: preview env ready: ef-preview-2024-11-18. Allowlist IPs: 18.205.14.9, 3.120.45.62.
Lina: SAML sample to send:
<Subject NameIDFormat="persistent">user.id</Subject>
<Attribute Name="email">user.email</Attribute>
<Attribute Name="groups">user.groups</Attribute>
Lina: SCIM notes: v2 supported, default rate ~10 req/s, delta sync + bulk for large orgs.
Raj: Propagation ~10-20s. If they need immediate enforcement recommend Dedicated/Private with webhook eventing and shorter cache TTLs.
Morgan: Action items — 1) Lina send SAML/SCIM snippets and ask for NameID preference and any SCIM extensions. 2) Customer to provide role list and expected sync cadence. 3) Sasha to produce Dedicated vs Private POC quote with support/compliance line items. 4) Legal to draft questionnaire answers and addendum for KMS. 5) Infra to provision preview and share allowlist IPs.
Sasha: I'll have a draft quote by tomorrow noon.
Morgan: I'll reach out to EdgeFrame for the role export and domain proof preference (TXT vs email). Recommend TXT.
